title: Set 3  What's in My Schoolbag?
subtitle: 对应课本：Unit 2 My schoolbag

dialogue.t: I have an English book, a maths book and two storybooks.
Do you have a Chinese book?
No, I don't. It's in my desk. What's in your schoolbag?
I have a notebook, a pencil case and some candy. Look!
Oh, my key! Where's my key?

vocab: schoolbag 书包 · maths book 数学书 · storybook 故事书 · notebook 笔记本 · pencil case 铅笔盒 · candy 糖果 · key 钥匙 · floor 地板

sections.title: A. 判断对错（T 对，F 错）

questions.why: Mike: I have an English book, a maths book...

questions.stem: Mike's Chinese book is in his schoolbag.
questions.why: 语文书在课桌里（in my desk）。
Sarah: ...a pencil case and some candy.

questions.stem: How many storybooks does Mike have?

questions.why: Mike: Look! It's on the floor.

questions.stem: What does Sarah have in her schoolbag? (Say one thing.)
questions.ref: 任选其一：A notebook. / A pencil case. / Some candy.
questions.why: Sarah: I have a notebook, a pencil case and some candy.
